title: Liquidity-conditioned short-horizon reversal
claim: Returns following one-sided flow reverse conditionally on thin depth and liquidity stress, after executable costs.
mechanism: Temporary inventory concessions reverse when liquidity providers absorb non-informational demand.
target: Subsequent executable return after a registered flow/depth shock
primaryBaseline: Unconditional return, zero return, persistence, and market-only liquidity controls

evidence.summary: The parent plan requires 180 continuous quality-valid days of depth and observed execution replay.

nextAction: Accumulate and audit 180 days; do not use the rejected unconditional candle adaptation as a substitute.
